name: Yamaji Yurino
source:
Sister and female teacher. She is serious and kind. Although she is still a newcomer, she is trying to be a good educator.

However, she is also introverted and a little frightened. She has a very attractive body that is disproportionate to her neat and clean face.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/st/index.html]official site[/url]]
